description:
Title: Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine

You develop an application that helps you with the inspection of a machine.
After entering the type of the machine, and its serial number, the inspection can begin:
* Questions are asked, and you have to input values.
* Buttons are to be pressed, and values are automatically collected from the machine and shown to you.
* Depending on the results, additional questions are asked (or not).
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Inspection"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/energy-drink-bottling-inspection">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Inspection" name="Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Inspection" name="Start inspection"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterMachineDetails" name="Enter machine type and serial number"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InspectionSplit" name="Perform inspection activities"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_InputInspectionValues" name="Input values for inspection questions"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PressMachineButtons" name="Press machine buttons"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CollectAndDisplayValues" name="Automatically collect and display machine values"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InspectionJoin" name="Inspection activities complete"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions" name="Do inspection results require additional questions?" default="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_InputAdditionalValues" name="Input values for additional questions"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Inspection" name="Inspection complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToDetails" sourceRef="StartEvent_Inspection" targetRef="Task_EnterMachineDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DetailsToSplit" sourceRef="Task_EnterMachineDetails" targetRef="Gateway_InspectionSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToQuestions" sourceRef="Gateway_InspectionSplit" targetRef="Task_InputInspectionValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToButtons" sourceRef="Gateway_InspectionSplit" targetRef="Task_PressMachineButtons"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_QuestionsToJoin" sourceRef="Task_InputInspectionValues" targetRef="Gateway_InspectionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ButtonsToCollect" sourceRef="Task_PressMachineButtons" targetRef="Task_CollectAndDisplayValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectToJoin" sourceRef="Task_CollectAndDisplayValues" targetRef="Gateway_InspectionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToDecision" sourceRef="Gateway_InspectionJoin" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalQuestionsRequired" name="Additional questions required" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Task_InputAdditionalValues">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${inspectionResultsRequireAdditionalQuestions}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions" name="No additional questions required" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions" targetRef="EndEvent_Inspection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalValuesToEnd" sourceRef="Task_InputAdditionalValues" targetRef="EndEvent_Inspection"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
